text:
Predicates:
Cost(x, y) ::: It costs x to take the GRE test.
Cheaper(x, y) ::: x is cheaper than y.
Provide(x, y) ::: x provides financial aid to y.
EconomicHardship(x) ::: x proves economic hardship.
SingleParentFamily(x) ::: x lives in a single-parent family.
FewResources(x) ::: x has few resources available to him.
Apply(x, y) ::: x is applying to take the GRE test.
Premises:
Cost(205, gre) ::: It costs $205 to take the GRE test.
Cheaper(205, 300) ::: which is cheaper than $300.
Provide(ets, tom) ↔ EconomicHardship(tom) ::: ETS provides financial aid to those GRE applicants who prove economic hardship.
EconomicHardship(tom) ↔ (SingleParentFamily(tom) ∨ FewResources(tom)) ::: Those living in single-parent families or having few resources available to them can prove economic hardship.
SingleParentFamily(tom) ::: Tom lives in a single-parent family.
FewResources(tom) ::: Tom has few resources available to him.
Apply(tom, gre) ::: Tom is applying to take the GRE test.
Conclusion:
Cheaper(205, 300) ::: It costs below US $300 to take the GRE test.
